drivingQuestion: Which is greater, a fast or charity?
outcomeNote: The reason is supplied and stands unchallenged.

segments.he: וְאָמַר רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר: גְּדוֹלָה תַּעֲנִית יוֹתֵר מִן הַצְּדָקָה. מַאי טַעְמָא — זֶה בְּגוּפוֹ, וְזֶה בְּמָמוֹנוֹ.
segments.en: After comparing and contrasting prayer and good deeds, the Gemara explores another comparison. «Rabbi Elazar said: A fast is greater than charity. What is the reason» that fasting is greater? Because a fast «is» a mitzva performed «with one’s body» as he afflicts himself, «while» charity «is» performed only «with one’s money.»
